caveat: The privileged container was required because this Docker kernel denied unprivileged user namespaces. This validates the bubblewrap namespace configuration, not the container's own containment. A production deployment must run the worker on a host or microVM where unprivileged user namespaces (or a rootless container runtime with the required namespaces) are enabled, and must not rely on --privileged.
findings: fork_bounded was stopped by the wall-clock kill rather than RLIMIT_NPROC; a hard fork bound needs a cgroup pids limit.
The probe does not test cgroup memory limits, seccomp, or microVM isolation.
The default system binds expose read-only /etc; a hardened image should minimize them.
